title: GoMotion demo is ready
body: Everything in this inbox is generated from bundled sample data. No account, message, or network request is involved.

title: MOVE10 applies to your next ride
body: A fictional 10% discount on demo fares above Rp 10.000. Pick it on the vehicle list or the review screen.

title: The demo kitchen is open
body: Three fictional restaurants are bundled with the app, along with their menus and demo prices.

title: GoSend keeps parcels on device
body: Sender, recipient, and package details never leave this device. The courier and every scan are simulated.

title: Rate a journey to earn demo points
body: Completed rides, orders, and parcels can be rated once from the Orders tab. Each rating adds fictional points to the demo wallet.
